query: select (select count(*)::int from public.knowledge_applications where status = 'active' and surface_ref like 'contextual-sense:%') as active_v2_applications, (select count(*)::int from public.learning_task_attempts where task_key = 'contextual-sense') as v2_attempt_rows, position('a_1.phase, a_1.answered_at, a_1.id' in pg_get_viewdef('public.learning_first_attempts'::regclass, true)) > 0 as first_attempt_uses_client_answered_at;
